about:
# EmotePanel for WoW: Forever

An eight-slot wheel for controller and mouse. Keep spells, items, macros, quick chat, and game shortcuts together. Customize Categories and Favorites, mark targets, send group pings, or use a separate Pet Wheel on Hunters and Warlocks.

Each character gets a profile named **Firstname Lastname**. Use **Profiles** in
Settings to switch setups or share selected settings and entries. **Default** is
the fresh-install preset. Upgrades retain existing characters’ setups. Use the
profile dropdown to review wheel keys that conflict with other WoW actions. The
Settings title bar shows the active profile and addon version.
Use `/ep reset` to confirm restoring the active profile to addon defaults.

## Get started

1. Install with [WowUp](https://wowup.io/addons/2798003) or [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/emote-panel/files). For a manual install, download the [Forever ZIP from GitHub](https://github.com/blazze11/EmotePanel/releases) and extract `EmotePanel` into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`.
2. Type `/ep setup` and press a key or controller button for the main wheel. Use **Wheel Keybinds** in **Help → Start Here** to reach the main and Pet Wheel keybinds in General.
3. Use your assigned keybind to open the wheel. Open **Actions** in Settings to add spells, items, and macros.

An open main wheel or Pet Wheel stays open when combat ends. You can keep using it as soon as WoW allows the selected action.

For **WoW: Forever 1.60.1**. ConsolePort is optional. Type `/ep help` or read the [Guide Book](https://github.com/blazze11/EmotePanel/wiki). Type `/ep new` for release highlights or see the [full changelog](https://github.com/blazze11/EmotePanel/blob/forever/CHANGELOG.md).

*Codex helped develop and document the Forever port.*

releases.name: EmotePanel 0.26.0 for WoW: Forever
releases.notes:
# 0.26.0 for WoW: Forever

- The main wheel and Pet Wheel stay open when combat ends.
- Animated icon rings and matching colors for target markers and pings.
- Find **Tint wheel segments** and **Tint strength** under **Customization → Display and feedback**.
- Fixed actions canceled by unrelated button releases in combat.

releases.name: EmotePanel 0.25.0 for WoW: Forever
releases.notes:
# EmotePanel 0.25.0 for WoW: Forever

- Keep your setup on upgrade. Use **Profiles** to switch, copy, or share it.
- Add mounts, companion pets, and toys to Actions.
- Enable **Ping System** to ping your target or yourself.
- Use `/ep setup` to bind the main wheel and `/ep reset` to reset the active profile.
- Settings reopens after combat. Use `/ep new` for the in-game changelog.

releases.name: EmotePanel 0.24.0 for WoW: Forever
releases.notes:
# EmotePanel 0.24.0 for WoW: Forever

- **Controller-first settings and Help.** Switch side tabs with the shoulder buttons, read an in-game guide with `/ep help`, and assign your wheel keybinds under General. `/ep` now opens settings.
- **Smoother wheels.** Both wheels fade, with optional sounds and vibration. Segment and page repeat have separate timing controls. Toggle the control legend with View / Select.
- **More ways to add Actions.** Add spells and items from ConsolePort’s spellbook and inventory menus. Automatic quest actions and the highest learned rank filter are enabled by default.
- **Target Marker and Player Interactions.** Mark your target or yourself, even in combat using the assigned wheel keybind. Find trade, follow, invites, and group actions together.
- **Customize entries and Favorites.** Add custom chat messages and emotes, pick WoW icons, and reorder an entry in both its category and Favorites from the same editor.
- **Pet Wheel updates.** Reopen the wheel after reviving your pet in combat. Call Pet refreshes its icon after a stable swap.

releases.name: EmotePanel 0.23.0 for WoW: Forever
releases.notes:
For **WoW: Forever 1.60.1**.

- **Pet Wheel for Hunters and Warlocks.** Assign up to two keybinds in Controller Setup. Use pet commands and toggle supported autocast in combat. Glows mark autocast and active commands or stances. Use **Entries → Pet** to reorder, hide, or customize actions.
- **Custom categories.** Give each shortcut its own name and icon. The Categories settings page shows its current icon.
- **Clearer action feedback.** See circular cooldowns, including the global cooldown, plus spell cast progress, interrupts, charges, and procs. Turn on **Show wheel tooltips** to see spell, item, macro, and pet details.
- **Mouse navigation.** Scroll up for the next page and down for the previous page. Right-click the center to go back or close. Scroll up from Categories to open Actions and down from Actions page 1 to return.
- **Controller setup.** Toggle WoW controller input in the addon settings. ConsolePort is optional. Turn off Blizzard's **Gamepad (Beta)** UI. Assigning a wheel keybind replaces an existing binding on that input.
- **Movement stick.** The stick stays locked through button presses. Turn off **Lock movement stick** if you want to move while aiming.
- **Emotes and chat.** Highlights use your WoW chat colors. Emote pages keep the control legend and hide the slash preview. Removed Lean and Faction Cheer from the built-in list.

releases.name: EmotePanel 0.22.31 for WoW: Forever
releases.notes:
For WoW: Forever 1.60.1.

- Set your wheel keybind right in **Controller Setup**. Categories and cooldown numbers are on by default, and settings have hover tips.
- Turn on **Remember last Action** to reopen the wheel at the last entry you used during this session. The ConsolePort cursor stays out of the way while the wheel is open.
- Say and Party each have **16 quick messages**, including campfire conversation starters. Default entries have distinct icons within each category, and Chicken and Eat swapped icons.
- Edit wheel entries with your controller. The editor shows button prompts and asks before discarding unsaved changes.
- Move the wheel with percentage sliders and arrow buttons. Uncheck an item marked **Not carried** to remove it from the Items list.
- Use **Reset to Defaults** to clear EmotePanel settings and customizations for all characters and reload the UI. Your WoW keybinds stay assigned.
